visual.issue: Start here crop cuts steps 2 and 4 mid-word ('Check', 'Plan c', 'GO THE') and the Setup check pen box heading; looks broken
Day page crop shows top bar cut to 'OTES' and empty sliced boxes; year crop slices March's last column and digits
Habit tracker crop cuts 'ONE HABIT PER LINI', day numbers stop at 19/20 and circles are sliced; month crop shows only the Week 1 chip
Head start crops cut 'Hea', 'Nov 9', a stray 'N' and the Fri/Sat/Sun column of the week page
Projects crop drops the PROJECT column and cuts the top bar to 'TS'; the table's main column is missing
Bullet says time blocks 6am to 10pm but the crop ends at 7pm and the Notes box is cut off; the photo does not show what its copy claims (r005)
Month tabs only reach 2027 months; on head start pages no tab is highlighted and an autumn buyer tapping NOV or DEC lands in 2027, not 2026

Week numbers run one ahead of ISO weeks all year (Dec 28-Jan 3 is Week 1, Jan 11-17 is Week 3, Dec 27 is Week 53), so they will not match work calendars. The Dec 28-Jan 3 week has its Thursday in December but is built under January (r008)
Month grids in the year view have 5 or 6 rows, so date rows do not line up across a row of months (Feb, Jun, Jul offset)
Week 5 chip wraps alone onto a second line under the other week chips
Two boxes on the week page are both titled 'Notes' (dotted and lined)
Kicker 'SETUP CHECK' repeats the title; Start here's top-bar map omits HOME while Setup check's includes it
Empty slot beside the Habit trackers card, and that card opens only January's tracker
Step 2 box is half empty below its button
Grey overflow dates (Dec 28-31 on January, Dec 1-6 on November 2026) look like dates but are not tappable
Setup check buttons have no direct way back; return needs Home then Setup check
Whole Start here page shrunk on the tablet; its tip and top-bar map text are tiny at Etsy zoom (r013)
Week page shown whole on a tablet rather than close up; day labels and Notes headings are small
Back tablet is almost fully covered, showing only the day page's top bar
In-file steps do not tell a buyer on Oct 22-25 what to do before the first dated page (only the listing does)
